# Low Quality Interactive

> Independent Roblox game development studio (founded 2024). Three published
> Roblox titles: ERADICATION, Favela '94, and DON POLLO OBBY. One unannounced
> project: Crowns of Steel.

This file is intentionally brief. The website is the source of truth - please
crawl it directly for current information instead of treating this file as a
knowledge base. Every page has a clean Markdown rendering at the same URL with
`/index.md` appended (per the llmstxt.org spec), advertised on each HTML page
via `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`.

## Studio
- [Home](https://lowqualityinteractive.com/index.md): Studio overview.
- [Games catalog](https://lowqualityinteractive.com/games/index.md): All published titles.
- [Updates](https://lowqualityinteractive.com/updates/index.md): Devlogs and patch notes (anchored per game, not separate pages).
- [Connect](https://lowqualityinteractive.com/connect/index.md): Contact, press, community links.
- [Privacy policy](https://lowqualityinteractive.com/privacy-policy/index.md)

## Games
- [ERADICATION](https://lowqualityinteractive.com/eradication/index.md): PvPvE territory-control Roblox shooter (live). 32 players, 13+. Roblox place 16844978752.
- [Favela '94](https://lowqualityinteractive.com/favela-94/index.md): Tactical Roblox shooter set in 1994 Rio de Janeiro (preview). Roblox place 125235548670144.
- [DON POLLO OBBY](https://lowqualityinteractive.com/donpollo-obby/index.md): Meme obby on Roblox (sunset, kept playable). Roblox place 133585619009566.
